title: Your Tax Dollars Could Still Be On The Line In Fight Over Trans Surgeries for Kids
summary: A Biden-appointed judge in Oregon has blocked a Trump administration declaration that labeled transgender medical procedures for children as unsafe and ineffective, siding with over a dozen Democratic attorneys general. This ruling is significant as it protects access to healthcare services for transgender youth amid efforts by the Trump administration to restrict federal funding for providers offering such treatments. The decision underscores ongoing legal and political battles over transgender rights and healthcare access in the U.S.
